name: lint-rules
title: Lint Rules (optional)
description: Optional oxlint config for Eskais UI consumers: the React, React Compiler and spacing-token presets of @p-otero/oxlint-rules, the @shadcn/lint design-system rules, eskais/icon-button-needs-label (an icon-only Button or Toggle takes size="icon" and an aria-label, so it shows a tooltip) and eskais/scroll-area as a warning (a bare overflow-auto or overflow-scroll class: scroll in a ScrollArea). Extend it from your .oxlintrc.json.
